page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1ne-c14d3.14xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.d1ne family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 56 dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 160.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 2.86 GB of RAM per core.

A defining characteristic of this instance is its massive bundled local storage capacity, consisting of 70866 GB of HDD storage. This high storage density is paired with a baseline network bandwidth of 35 Gbps. No graphics processing units are included in this configuration.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the server offers a high ratio of local hard disk drive storage capacity relative to compute and memory resources, making it suitable for workloads requiring dense, localized data storage without the premium cost of solid-state drives. The trade-off is the reliance on HDD technology, which offers lower random I/O performance compared to NVMe or SSD alternatives.

This hardware profile is designed for workloads such as large-scale data warehousing, distributed file systems, big data analytics, and cold or warm data storage applications that benefit from high capacity and sequential throughput rather than high random IOPS.
